Everything can pass...

The payoff?
 • 70% faster regression
 • 3.2× more automation coverage
 • 190% estimated three-year ROI

Architecture has evolved. Testing has to evolve with it.

The biggest automation challenge in Temenos isn't speed.
It's stability.

Migrating from Selenium to Playwright may improve execution—but both still rely on static locator identities. When AMR patches regenerate IDs or restructure the DOM, maintenance becomes inevitable.

Resilient automation starts with changing the architecture, not just the framework.
